diagram.manim_description: On a white BG canvas of 1920 x 1080 px draw a table of 3 columns and 6 rows, 1740 px wide (column widths 520, 700 and 520 px) and 900 px high (row height 150 px), centred on the canvas, all cell borders INK 2 px. Row 1 is the header, filled MARK_FILL, holding the bold INK texts 'Sweets', 'Tally Marks' and 'No. of Students', centred in their cells, 44 px high. Rows 2 to 6 have BG fill; the first cell of each holds the sweet name in INK, centred, 44 px high: row 2 'Jalebi', row 3 'Gulab jamun', row 4 'Gujiya', row 5 'Barfi', row 6 'Rasgulla'. The middle cell of each row holds INK tally marks, the whole run centred in the cell. A tally stroke is a vertical INK line 3 px thick and 72 px high; strokes of one bundle stand 30 px apart. A bundle of five is four vertical strokes plus one diagonal INK stroke 3 px thick running from 8 px left of the first stroke and 6 px above its top, down to 8 px right of the fourth stroke and 6 px below its bottom, crossing all four strokes (top-left to bottom-right). A gap of 40 px separates a bundle from the next bundle and from the loose strokes; loose strokes are single vertical strokes 30 px apart. Row 2 (Jalebi): 1 bundle, then 1 loose stroke. Row 3 (Gulab jamun): 1 bundle, then 4 loose strokes. Row 4 (Gujiya): 2 bundles, then 3 loose strokes. Row 5 (Barfi): 3 loose strokes and no bundle. Row 6 (Rasgulla): 1 bundle, then 2 loose strokes. The third cell of row 2 holds the INK number '6' and the third cell of row 3 holds the INK number '9', both centred, 44 px high. The third cells of rows 4, 5 and 6 hold no number, only one short INK underline 240 px long and 2 px thick, centred in the cell near its lower edge.
